intent: Independently verify full-baseline expansion, unchanged-output reuse and prompt-only comparison before generating missing baseline responses.
scope: Refinement helper and expanded baseline integrity only; a future candidate prompt requires its own independent review.

baseline.validation: Auditor ran validateManifest and generations locally using only preserved responses, then compared every copied result, check, repetition and source-file hash with its original evidence. No provider calls were made.

verified: Reuse selects every available identical fixed-input record when prompt, input and expected labels match. It does not filter by pass/fail or choose favorable repetitions.
All 120 original logical records, including all 41 failing records, are preserved with source evidence links and raw provider evidence; only new run identity metadata is added.
A changed prompt reuses no old target predictions. Current handler, reducer, sampling, coverage, gates, partitions, aliases and original regression slice must match before comparison.

Both baseline and candidate must have complete evidence. Candidate behavioral gates, semantic pairs, classification gates and per-group non-regression remain required; pending human labels and independent unseen validation are explicitly separate from benchmark conformance.
Prompt replacement now uses the exact TypeScript initializer span. Adjacent non-prompt declarations and consumer code survive normalization and cause comparison rejection.
compare checks the live refinement-helper hash against both frozen artifacts, while the shared runner verifies its own scorer/consumer/request evidence.

resolved_finding.initial_reproduction: The previous declaration-to-interface string replacement incorrectly accepted an inserted non-prompt constant before VerifiedPrincipal as a prompt-only change.
resolved_finding.resolution: AST initializer replacement preserves neighboring code. The auditor independently reran the insertion check against the updated helper and confirmed rejection. A source identity guard was added for the refinement comparator.

tests.coordinating_agent_result: 26 focused deterministic tests passed, including the new adjacent-code comparator regression.
tests.auditor_checks: Independent in-memory non-prompt drift rejection, all-copy provenance equality, manifest validation and frozen-handler replay of the 120 copied records.

limitations: This artifact authorizes no claim of model improvement; the missing full baseline and future candidate were unrun at review time.
Total associated provider calls include inherited calls. Only 234 new independent calls are required to finish this baseline; existing successes and failures must not be resampled.
Human gold-label review and independent unseen validation remain pending. Historical exposed cases do not establish unseen generalization.
full-baseline-20261015-01 remains an unrun superseded freeze; its preserved files are not counted as additional independent samples.
Material changes to these inspected sources invalidate this helper audit.
